**Chapter 3: Structure of Matter**

**3.1 Symbols of Elements**

The abbreviated form of English or Latin name of an element is called its symbol. Each element has its own symbol. There is a system of writing a symbol of an element.

| Element | Symbol |
| --- | --- |
| Hydrogen | H |
| Oxygen | O |
| Nitrogen | N |

The first letter of an English name of an element is usually the symbol and that has to be written using capital letters. For example, the symbol of Hydrogen is (H), the symbol of carbon (C) and the symbol of oxygen (O) etc.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Carbon | C | Cobalt | Co |
| Chlorine | Cl | Cadmium | Cd |
| Calcium | Ca | Chromium | Cr |
